scope: Primary-source review for the next push. New sources AST-S034..053 supplement the existing33-source manifest; AST-S007,012,020 have additional passage reviews.

sources.title: Zhu's algebra and the C2-algebra of a classically free vertex operator algebra
sources.version: v1,2026-06-12; no later version shown on the abstract page
reviewed_passages: Section6.3, equations6.3.1–6.3.2 and final dimension contradiction
sources.used_for: Published non-freeness benchmark and the exact old mixed-quotient definition.
sources.claim_boundary: Does not supply an all-weight E8 arc-kernel presentation. The project weight4 certificate is compared with this existing theorem.

sources.title: Classical freeness of affine sl_n at level1 via combinatorics
reviewed_passages: Introduction paragraphs on Song–Zeng and the Buchberger strategy
sources.used_for: A recent primary follow-up citing Song–Zeng; explicit leading-term and Hilbert-series completion strategy.
sources.claim_boundary: The theorem is for typeA. It is a method lead, not an E8 freeness or kernel theorem.

sources.title: Zhu's algebra, the C2-algebra, and twisted modules
reviewed_passages: SectionIV.3, E8 C2 dimension4125 and module decomposition
SectionIV.5, E8 anomaly and level caveats
sources.used_for: Earlier C2 algebra information and separation from Zhu and arc-map kernels.
sources.claim_boundary: The C2-versus-Zhu anomaly is not itself the later explicit differential arc-kernel classification.

sources.title: Young wall realizations of level1 irreducible highest weight and Fock space crystals of quantum affine algebras in typeE
reviewed_passages: Sections3.2 and3.3.2, E8 energy and Young columns
Theorems4.9–4.10, reduced Young walls and the basic crystal
sources.used_for: Concrete E8 affine combinatorics for a prospective normal-monomial bijection.
sources.claim_boundary: A crystal realization is not a Gröbner basis of the augmented arc ideal; that map must still be constructed.

sources.title: Unitarity of the KZ/Hitchin connection on conformal blocks in genus0 for arbitrary Lie algebras
sources.used_for: Compactness after identifying the five-dimensional level4 system with the full conformal-block bundle.
sources.claim_boundary: The moduli-space descent is projectively unitary. Unit-modulus determinants are a separate input for the chosen linear lift.

sources.title: Fusion Rules for Affine Kac-Moody Algebras
reviewed_passages: Theorem6.3 and the highest-root sl2 argument
sources.used_for: Fusion equals tensor product when k is at least the highest-root pairing of the sum of the two highest weights.
sources.claim_boundary: For adjoint E8 this gives k>=4, not a physical five-channel adjoint-primary block at level1.

sources.title: Finite Linear Quotients of B3 of Low Dimension
reviewed_passages: Lemma5.1(d) and its finite primitive group proof
sources.used_for: Finite-image exclusion in degree 5 using projective generator order.
sources.claim_boundary: Lemma5.1 is a finite primitive linear-group restriction independent of a B3 extension. It proves infinitude, not compact density.

sources.title: Representations of the braid group B3 and of SL(2,Z)
sources.used_for: Classification of irreducible B3 representations through degree 5 by eigenvalue and determinant-root data.
sources.claim_boundary: Applying it requires actual half-braids and a checked braid relation; two pure loops do not automatically supply those data.

sources.title: The N-eigenvalue Problem and Two Applications
sources.used_for: A primary template for reducing compact closures to connected simple factors.
sources.claim_boundary: Its generating-conjugacy-class hypothesis must be checked. The pure-loop argument instead states its own prime-dimension Clifford reduction.

sources.title: Symmetry Principles in Quantum Systems Theory
sources.used_for: The only compact simple algebras with a faithful irreducible complex representation of degree 5 are su5,so5,and su2 of highest weight4.
sources.claim_boundary: The2014 erratum changes a different alternating-square table. The degree 5 classification is also independently obtained from the Weyl dimension formula.

sources.title: Geometry and classification of solutions of the classical dynamical Yang-Baxter equation
reviewed_passages: Introduction KZB system with Cartan derivatives
sources.used_for: All-type classical dynamical elliptic r-matrix with spectral parameter, including E8.
sources.claim_boundary: Zero-weight, coupling, spectral and gauge assumptions matter. A dynamical elliptic solution is not a nondynamical Belavin matrix.

sources.title: Universal KZB Equations for arbitrary root systems
sources.used_for: A root-system E8 KZB construction and explicit finite families of algebra relations for its realization.
sources.claim_boundary: The connection is universal and completed. A finite matrix realization requires a homomorphism satisfying all defining relations.

sources.title: The elliptic Casimir connection of a simple Lie algebra
sources.used_for: An E8-valid specialization into a deformed double current algebra, with flatness and degeneration theorems.
sources.claim_boundary: The cited version labels the quantum-toroidal monodromy identification as a conjecture; the audit does not promote it to a theorem.

sources.title: Elliptic quantum groups and their finite-dimensional representations
sources.used_for: All-type half-current and dynamical representation framework.
sources.claim_boundary: The dense subcategory, spectral noncollision and meromorphic coefficient field must be retained; a plain vector-space functor does not supply a finite E8 R matrix automatically.

sources.title: En Jacobi forms and Seiberg-Witten curves
sources.used_for: W(E8)-invariant lattice theta normalization, rank8 elliptic variable, and index1 form.
sources.claim_boundary: Its historical discussion of unknown E8 ring generators is superseded by AST-S046.

sources.title: The ring of Weyl invariant E8 Jacobi forms
sources.used_for: Current complete ring theorem via joint covariants of a binary quartic and sextic.
sources.claim_boundary: Finite generation and the194-generator result are established literature, not new Asterion closure targets.

sources.title: Construction of spherical cubature formulas using lattices
sources.used_for: Every E8 shell is a spherical7-design; strength 8 is equivalent to vanishing of the corresponding Ramanujan tau coefficient.
sources.claim_boundary: A finite shell census does not prove Lehmer nonvanishing for every positive integer.

sources.title: Constructing Chayet-Garibaldi algebras from affine vertex algebras (including the3876-dimensional algebra for E8)
sources.used_for: Existing affine-VOA construction of the symmetric weight-two3876-dimensional algebra.
sources.claim_boundary: This nonassociative product is distinct from the commutative C2 product and the differential arc kernel.

sources.title: Semisimple subalgebras of semisimple Lie algebras
reviewed_passages: Bibliographic record and classification provenance only; the full Russian proof was not reviewed
sources.used_for: Historical provenance of semisimple-subalgebra classification.
sources.claim_boundary: The audit relies on the explicitly reviewed degree 5 table and a stated small-rank derivation, not on an unreviewed Dynkin table.

sources.title: Conformal field theory and integrable systems associated to elliptic curves
reviewed_passages: Section2, equations3–5, KZB kernels and dynamical compatibility
Section3, equation6, the quantum dynamical shifts
sources.used_for: Original elliptic dynamical construction and distinction between the z connection and modular tau equation.
sources.claim_boundary: The displayed explicit quantum vector matrix is typeA; it is not an E8 quantum adjoint R matrix.

sources.title: On the dynamical Yang-Baxter equation
sources.version: 2002 primary review by a theorem author
sources.used_for: The exact plus-theta kernel convention, unitarity, Casimir residue and all-type rational/trigonometric degenerations used by the implementation.
sources.claim_boundary: The classical example is valid for every reductive algebra. Its existence does not itself supply a certified quantum E8 exchange matrix.

sources.title: Monodromy groups of parameterized linear differential equations with regular singularities
sources.used_for: The regular-singular pointwise identification of differential Galois group with monodromy Zariski closure.
sources.claim_boundary: The parameterized Kolchin-density theorem is a different statement. No parameterized Galois group or parameter-wide Zariski-open claim is inferred.

sources.title: An algorithm for computing weight multiplicities in irreducible modules for complex semisimple Lie algebras
reviewed_passages: Theorem2 and its distinct conditional improved recursion
sources.used_for: The classical Freudenthal recursion and Weyl symmetry underlying the exact bounded character engine.
sources.claim_boundary: The implementation uses the classical recursion, not an asserted new multiplicity formula or Cavallin's conditional improved formula. Its E8 outputs still require exact reconstruction checks.
